title: Torsional ultrasound modality for hard nucleus phacoemulsification cataract extraction

license.statement: CC BY, version not stated (article <license>: 'open-access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License, which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original work is properly cited'); no licence URL in the article

indication: Age-related cataract with Emery-Little nuclear hardness grade IV (hard nucleus); pupil at least 7 mm, ECD above 1200 cells/mm2; diabetic retinopathy, glaucoma, AMD, uveitis and previous intraocular surgery excluded

groups.description: Linear torsional combined with longitudinal ultrasound power (Lin Tor+US, Alcon Infiniti OZil), quick chop, 3.2 mm temporal clear corneal incision, DuoVisc soft-shell; randomized; single surgeon
100% fixed torsional amplitude (Fixed Tor, Alcon Infiniti OZil), quick chop, 3.2 mm temporal clear corneal incision, DuoVisc soft-shell; randomized; single surgeon

Conventional longitudinal ultrasound burst mode (US group, the study's control group; max power 60%, burst width 40 ms, off time 30 ms), quick chop, 3.2 mm temporal clear corneal incision, DuoVisc soft-shell; randomized; single surgeon

exclusions.reason: The same table gives absolute CCT; the absolute series are used
Test statistics and p-values are not admissible
Thickness at the incision, not central corneal thickness

exclusions.what: Tables 2, 3 and 6 (UST/CDE, BCVA, endothelial cell counts)

notes: Roles: the article randomizes two torsional (OZil) modalities against 'the control group using Ultrasound burst mode'; the torsional arms are the evaluated experimental modality (treated) and conventional US burst is the control.

Source inconsistency: in Table 4 the µm 'Change' entries do not equal the difference between the tabulated postoperative and preoperative means (same offset in all three groups at days 1 and 7, and at day 30 in the Lin Tor+US and Fixed Tor groups); the percent entries follow the µm change entries. The absolute means are cited as tabulated, per protocol.
CCT measured on a 180° single Visante OCT scan through the central light reflex (Methods, postoperative outcomes paragraph); the preoperative measuring device is not stated separately.
One incisional burn occurred in the US group; no posterior capsule rupture in any group.

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT of the operated eye (Table 4 row 'Preop (SD)', 'Corneal thickness' column); Visante OCT 1000 (Methods)
series.notes: Table 4 'Lin Tor+US' corneal-thickness column; mean (SD) in µm; post-op days 1, 7 and 30 (days/30.4375). Per-visit n not reported (66 eyes randomized).
